english_draft:
This document is a historical reconstruction. It is not a contemporaneous forecast. Use only Meta's first quarter 2026 results published on April 29, 2026.

Q1 2026 baseline: Revenue was 56.311 billion USD. Revenue increased 33 percent year over year. Operating income was 22.872 billion USD. Operating margin was 41 percent. Diluted EPS was 10.44 USD. Net income included an 8.03 billion USD income tax benefit. Excluding this benefit would reduce diluted EPS by 3.13 USD. Family daily active people averaged 3.56 billion in March 2026. This was up 4 percent year over year. Ad impressions increased 19 percent year over year.

Q2 2026 core questions:
1. Will total revenue growth remain near 33 percent?
2. Will operating margin remain near 41 percent?
3. Will ad impressions growth remain near 19 percent?

Expectation gaps: Use Q1 2026 as the reference, not a market consensus. Positive signals: revenue growth close to 33 percent and operating margin close to 41 percent. Negative signals: clear slowdown in revenue growth, clear decline in operating margin, or simultaneous slowdown in user and ad impressions growth.

Verification points: In the Q2 report, check revenue, operating income, operating margin, diluted EPS, tax items, family daily active people, and ad impressions. Do not compare diluted EPS directly with Q1 without adjusting for the tax benefit.
reader_questions: 本稿特意以2026Q1为基准、不使用市场共识；读者会不会把正面/负面信号误读成对2026Q2的确定性预测？
2026Q1的摊薄EPS 10.44美元包含80.3亿美元所得税收益，剔除后EPS减少3.13美元；若Q2没有同类收益，直接比较同比EPS是否会严重误导？
广告展示量同比增19%而总收入同比增33%，二者之差能否直接证明‘单次展示价格上升’？如果Q2两个增速背离，应该优先看哪个指标？
fact_checks: 第一轮：所有数字均来自指定的Meta 2026Q1财报，日期为截至2026年3月31日；币种为USD；金额单位为十亿美元/美元；口径为集团GAAP；未使用分部、非GAAP或外部共识。
第一轮：收入563.11亿美元、经营利润228.72亿美元、经营利润率41%、摊薄EPS 10.44美元、所得税收益80.3亿美元及EPS影响3.13美元、家族日活35.6亿、广告展示量+19%等与facts逐项一致。
第二轮：‘收入增速接近33%’和‘经营利润率接近41%’只是以Q1为参照的分析性场景，不是公司指引或市场共识；正文已标注。
第二轮：正文未把扣除税项收益后的EPS作为核心结论，只说明Q1净利含税项收益、Q2 EPS不宜直接对比。
第二轮：‘单次展示价格变化’未在Q1财报中直接披露，正文已标注为本稿推论；未将其表述为财报事实。
